name: ho
description: ho monorepo - ingest radar pipeline (Python) + autofill product (Python + TypeScript)

scripts.check: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run mypy && bun run --filter 'autofill-node*' lint && bun run --filter 'autofill-node*' format:check && bun run --filter 'autofill-node*' typecheck
scripts.test: uv run python -m pytest . -v --ignore=refs && bun run --filter 'autofill-node*' test
